o1: Enables GTPase activator activity. Involved in regulation of the actomyosin cytoskeleton; asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; cortical actin cytoskeleton organization; and regulation of actin filament-based process. Is located in cell cortex and centrosome. Is expressed in embryo; germ line; and pharyngeal muscle cell. Interacts with RHO-1. RGA-3 exacerbates the gonadal defect phenotype in let-502(sb106) mutants. Orthologous to human ARHGAP11A (Rho GTPase activating protein 11A).
